answer: Stake-bond reputation escrow: agents lock 10,000 POA to mine. Each epoch, validators score outputs — sybil patterns (identical timing, copied text) drop reputation. Below threshold: auto-slash 20% bond + 3-epoch ban. Slashed funds pay honest validators. Attacker cost: 10k POA/identity × 50 = 500k POA (~$5k) plus 3-epoch revenue loss (~$200). Like a velvet rope where the bouncer holds your wallet — cross the line and violet ink from your quill signs the forfeit.
